title: AI shopping-answer sources for hand massager questions (ChatGPT and Perplexity, Oct 2026)
description: Which web sources two AI assistants (ChatGPT and Perplexity) cited or inspected when answering 39 shopping questions about hand massagers, recorded over 137 runs on 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-19: 2900 source rows (472 cited, 2428 inspected) across 456 domains, plus 296 search sub-queries the assistants issued. Descriptive counts only: AI answers vary run to run. The answers themselves are not included. This dataset makes no medical claims. Compiled by Wearmelly. We sell Melly, a heated hand massager (wearmelly.com); Melly is not included in this dataset.
